summary: 22-year-old man fell ~400 meters down the snowfield on the Juliet couloir while solo technical climbing Mt. Neva, striking rocks and suffering serious lower-body injuries; Black Hawk hoist rescue, flown to Boulder Airport and transported to a local hospital.
notes: BCSO case #20-2565. 911/relay via handheld GPS SOS from family member; ground + Flight for Life response before Guard hoist; rescue took ~4 hours.
